description:
I. Perform receptionist duties
II. Team Leader responsibilities:
* Oversee reception operations and the team’s tasks.
* Implement corporate health check (monitor schedules, create packages, prepare lists, and notify branches of issues related to health check groups).
* Liaise and coordinate with Sales, Cashiers, Nurses, Health Check team, IT, Lab, and branches in deploying health check programs.
* Support, assign, and monitor the finalization of health check groups; hand over related documentation.
* Arrange the team’s work schedules and coordinate staffing in urgent or unexpected situations.
* Train new receptionists; monitor, evaluate, and provide updates to direct management.
* Support the team in handling situations (difficult customers, incorrect package pricing, information or service issues, system errors, etc.) and seek approval from supervisors when necessary.
* Follow doctors’ schedules and contact them when needed.
* Monitor monthly inventory and usage of supplies and office stationery.
requirements_text:
* Leadership skills
* Communication skills
* Team management skills
* Planning & execution skills
* Problem-solving skills
* College or University degree preferred.
* More than 2 years of working experience in healthcare, service industries as a receptionist or team leader .
* Good communication skills in both English and Vietnamese; additional languages such as Japanese or Korean is a plus.
